name: STAYED_HAND
canonical: Aged Abraham, grey-bearded in a simple robe, kneeling alone on a rocky summit, his face and one open empty hand lifted high toward a radiant break of holy light above, overcome with relief and awe. Close before him a single ram is caught fast by its curled horns in a low thicket of dry branches. The moment the LORD provided the ram as the substitute. Rocky Moriah summit, plain wilderness, reverent, no other figures.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
